raw_response: {"diagnosis": "Thirty txn_ids have a second row with record_version=2, most likely restatements delivered in the oversized batch 14. silver_transactions keeps every version, so these transactions are double-counted in silver and all gold tables; the fix keeps only the latest version of each txn_id before applying the POSTED filter.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.8, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM (SELECT * FROM raw_transactions QUALIFY row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY txn_id ORDER BY record_version DESC, ingest_ts DESC, batch_id DESC) = 1) d WHERE status = 'POSTED'"}}
